notes: São Martinho S.A. (B3: SMTO3) — one of Brazil's largest sugar/ethanol producers. Four mills (São Martinho, Iracema, Santa Cruz, Boa Vista) primarily in São Paulo + Goiás. Crushing capacity ~24 Mt cane/yr. Owns / controls ~165k hectares (~408k acres) of sugarcane area. FY ends MARCH 31 (e.g., FY24/25 = Apr 2024 → Mar 2025). All figures BRL-mm IFRS consolidated. Receita bruta ≈ net revenue × ~1.10 (PIS/COFINS, ICMS).

periods.notes: FY20/21 (FY ends Mar-21): Revenue R$3.86bn, EBITDA R$2.14bn (margin 55.4%) — strong sugar prices.
FY21/22 (Mar-22): Revenue R$4.96bn (+28%), EBITDA R$2.52bn (margin 50.9%). Frost-impacted 21/22 cane harvest offset by record prices.
FY22/23 (Mar-23): Revenue R$6.15bn (+24%), EBITDA R$3.01bn (margin 49.0%) — record EBITDA on strong ethanol-sugar mix.
FY23/24 (Mar-24): Revenue R$5.91bn (-4%), EBITDA R$2.82bn (margin 47.7%). Ethanol prices fell; sugar mix increased.

FY24/25 (Mar-25): Revenue R$6.41bn (+8%), EBITDA R$2.75bn (margin 42.8%) — record sugar production but lower unit margins on cane TCH/ATR pressure from drought + fires. Leverage 1.85x. Dividends R$540M.
